evidence.detail: Three CSS files loaded synchronously: main CSS via cache-busted querystring, /banner/banner.css (dynamically generated), and keyrune.css from CDN — no critical-CSS inlining or defer exists

Author states 'I'm not sure the complexity here is worth the savings' and identifies intro box (loaded by JS after an API call) as bigger mobile culprit; intro box requires rethinking JS-based visibility to avoid needing a JS-gated API call
No commits found addressing CSS splitting, critical CSS inlining, or deferred stylesheet loading

triage.notes: The author has actively monitored PageSpeed scores over years with varying results; the core open question is whether to inline critical CSS and defer the rest, and how to handle the intro box without a JS-gated API call. Both require owner judgment on complexity vs benefit tradeoff.
